verdict.rationale: Asana documents mechanisms for cross-tool/agent handoff: APIs/webhooks to sync data with other tools (asana-docs-2, asana-docs-4, asana-docs-9, asana-docs-11), an MCP server enabling agent connectivity (asana-probe-3), and 'shared memory' for AI Teammates that carries forward task history and preferences so context isn't repeated (asana-docs-12), plus governed agent identity/audit trails (asana-docs-13). However all evidence is vendor-authored marketing/docs with no independent or hands-on validation that context is actually preserved across real handoffs between tools/agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of lossless context transfer, concrete example of a multi-tool handoff workflow, and any community confirmation of shared-memory reliability.
